name: CZ-1
description: CZ-1 was a CZ-series secretary/business communications droid that was paired with CZ-3, another droid of the same model. After a crash left him abandoned on the planet Tatooine, CZ-1 became separated from CZ-3 and ended up in a pile of scrap on board a Jawa sandcrawler, where he encountered the astromech droid R2-D2 in 1 BBY.
